title: The King of Fighters 2002
subtitle: Three fighters return to the foreground
summary: The King of Fighters 2002 is Eolith's team fighting game, first released for Neo Geo on 10 October 2002 and published by Playmore.
body: The King of Fighters 2002 is Eolith's team fighting game, first released for Neo Geo on 10 October 2002 and published by Playmore. It gathers returning characters in another dream match after the NESTS storyline, bringing the series back to three-on-three battles. The selection places familiar teams from different years beside one another, with Omega Rugal returning as the final opponent. Its central changes concern the power gauge and MAX activation, giving players more ways to turn a stored resource into an immediate opportunity during an exchange.

The power gauge fills through attacks and special techniques, with later teammates able to hold more stocks. A stock can support a strong special move or a defensive answer while blocking, so spending it means choosing between immediate damage and preserving another response. MAX activation provides another option, opening a short period in which attacks can be cancelled into other moves. The system makes the order of the team relevant to resource management as well as character matchups, because each remaining fighter enters with a different potential capacity.

During MAX activation, the player can connect actions that would otherwise end separately, creating routes into more elaborate combinations. Stronger MAX techniques ask for additional resources or low health, making their availability part of reading the round. The large returning cast gives those systems many different move sets to work with. A later remake, Unlimited Match, expanded and revised the game, but the original's appeal already rested on this direct relationship: earn power through the fight, recognise an opening and decide how much of that reserve to commit to it.
